# DERIVED FILE: do not edit by hand. public/_headers is rendered by scripts/render-headers.mjs from the core template
# scripts/headers.core.txt (locked, synced by sync-core) plus the merchant's own origins in merchant.headers.json (human-owned,
# never overwritten by a sync). scripts/check-layers.mjs fails when this file is not byte-identical to that rendering.
# Cloudflare Workers static assets / Pages read this file from the assets directory (public/) and send these headers with
# every response. The file itself is not served.
#
# A STRICT CONTENT-SECURITY-POLICY IS A DEPLOYMENT REQUIREMENT for production and for every AI-edit preview of the
# storefront (decided by the user, 2026-11-25; docs/DECISIONS.md). scripts/check-layers.mjs fails when this file is
# missing, has no CSP, or weakens it (unsafe-inline / unsafe-eval / wildcard in script-src, no object-src 'none',
# no base-uri, no frame-ancestors). Design sessions must not edit it; a change is a human-reviewed core change
# (.claude/skills/core-change).
#
# Why each directive (the storefront is build-less, so the policy is simple):
#   script-src 'self'           only same-origin files run: no inline scripts, no eval, no third-party scripts.
#                               (index.html has no inline <script>; the optional localhost override is loaded from
#                               commerce/local-config.js.)
#   style-src 'self'            stylesheets from public/ only (see the extras line below).
#   style-src-attr 'unsafe-inline'  the design layer sets product photos as inline style="background-image:..." attributes
#                               (imgCss in app.js). Style ATTRIBUTES cannot run code; style elements stay blocked.
#   img-src 'self' data: + the merchant's image origin (imageOrigin, plus extraImg if declared). data: is the favicon.
#                               Product photos come from the platform's public image host, which is per merchant, so it is
#                               declared in merchant.headers.json (decision D20); there is no blanket https: any more.
#   connect-src 'self' + the merchant's platform API origin (apiOrigin, plus extraConnect if declared). This is the storefront's
#                               ONLY network egress for scripts: a hostile or buggy design layer cannot send customer data to
#                               another origin with fetch, XHR, WebSocket, EventSource or sendBeacon.
#   style-src / font-src 'self' (+ extraStyle / extraFont if the merchant declares them), frame-src 'none' (+ extraFrame).
#   form-action 'self' + ECPay  checkout builds a <form method=POST> and submits it to the ECPay payment host returned by
#                               the platform (public/commerce/checkout.js submitPaymentForm). Only the two ECPay payment
#                               hosts are added (production and stage); everything else stays blocked. Chromium also
#                               applies form-action to the redirect chain after the POST, so a 302 from ECPay to another
#                               host would be blocked: verify with the ECPay sandbox before go-live and add that host if
#                               it ever appears (Firefox does not check redirects). The return from ECPay to the shop is
#                               a navigation initiated by ECPay's page, not governed by this policy.
#   frame-ancestors 'none', object-src 'none', base-uri 'none': no framing, plugins, <base> hijack.
#
# Other headers: HSTS (1 year, includeSubDomains; no preload, a human decision), Permissions-Policy (all powerful features
# off; the storefront needs none), COOP same-origin (no window.opener link to or from other origins; ECPay is reached by a
# top-level navigation, not a popup, so payment is unaffected).
#
# An AI-edit PREVIEW environment must serve the same policy (it may add its own preview/API origins to connect-src and
# img-src, never 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval' for scripts).
#
# The CSP line below carries one token per configurable directive (style, img, font, connect, frame); the renderer fills them.
/*
  Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src {{STYLE_SRC}}; style-src-attr 'unsafe-inline'; img-src {{IMG_SRC}}; font-src {{FONT_SRC}}; connect-src {{CONNECT_SRC}}; frame-src {{FRAME_SRC}}; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self' https://payment.ecpay.com.tw https://payment-stage.ecpay.com.tw; object-src 'none'
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
  X-Frame-Options: DENY
  Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains
  Permissions-Policy: accelerometer=(), camera=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=()
  Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin
